input_contract.preservation: Exact source tokens, their order and single separating spaces are preserved. Paragraph breaks are explicit reset boundaries; ordinary physical line wraps do not reset. Capitalization and listed punctuation are preserved. Repeated whitespace and exact original lineation are outside this canonical input contract. An unlisted character is an explicit coverage failure, never silently normalized or dropped.
input_contract.unknown_words: There is no lexical dictionary. Every new word over the declared character inventory is handled by exactly the same per-character rules. No ingredient, action, scope, comparison, pronoun or negation is replaced by a semantic label.
input_contract.rare_encoding: For zero-based index j in additional_characters_in_order, write y, then working_glyphs[floor(j/22)], then working_glyphs[j mod22]. All three marks form one character. Reject unused indices. Rare characters do not update the ordinary-letter state.
input_contract.meanings: The shapes are familiar working transcription labels used for an artificial demonstration. This is not a native atomic inventory, source-language identification or Voynich sound/word assignment.

common_readability: A decoder reads code units inside each visible source-word group and reproduces every input character. It starts from the public paragraph initialization and updates only from previously decoded characters. No source plaintext, per-message side table or private identifier is needed. Random access to a middle word without earlier paragraph state is not promised.

title: RAW UNREVIEWED: independent two-spelling alternators for each ordinary source letter
summary: Each of26 source letters owns its own two-position tick. Every occurrence uses that letter's current explicit alias and flips only its own tick. The complete source is recoverable through a small letter table; no whole-word dictionary or source-word history is needed.

design.purpose: A concrete hand cipher with controlled alternation of repeated source letters, rather than a new arbitrary code for each word. No historical use or statistical fit is asserted.
design.initialization: At every paragraph start set all26 letter ticks to0. Carry them across words and ordinary line wraps. Both encoder and decoder keep the same26-row marked card.
encode: For a lowercase source letter with alphabetic index i, take j=2*i+tick[i]. Emit the fixed alias j described below, then replace tick[i] by1-tick[i].
For a listed additional character use the common y escape and leave all26 ticks unchanged. Copy source word spaces and paragraph breaks.

alias_carrier.mapping: Alias indices0..18 use the19 direct signs in listed order. Indices19..40 use q followed by working_glyphs[j-19]. Indices41..51 use r followed by working_glyphs[j-41]. No alias begins with y; unsupported selectors are malformed.
alias_carrier.inverse: A direct sign, q plus one selector, or r plus one selector uniquely supplies alias index j. Recover i=floor(j/2), b=j mod2. Require b=tick[i], emit the corresponding lowercase letter and flip that tick. A wrong alternating alias is noncanonical even if its underlying letter is legible.

design.learning_and_operation: One26-letter/two-alias table, the common56-character auxiliary table and26 independent tick marks. There are potentially2^26 global states, not merely two global states; the representation is26 bits rather than a huge precomputed table. Each ordinary character requires one tick lookup/update.
design.single_and_repeated_inputs: A single letter is always legal. Abstract source 'aaa' uses a's aliases0,1,0 within one paragraph. Other intervening letters do not change a's tick. Two identical source words can differ, depending on the parity of their letter counts; no copy operation erases either word.
design.exact_unequal_consequence: Successive occurrences of each same lowercase source letter must alternate aliases, even across intervening words. Applying any fixed source word twice restores all ticks to their original values. Therefore a directly repeated source word has at most a two-cycle of written forms; arbitrary context-conditioned word variants need not obey this.
design.strongest_countercase: A word in which every lowercase letter occurs an even number of times changes no tick and repeats with exactly the same spelling. The mechanism cannot freely diversify such words. Conversely one wrong alias or omitted character can desynchronize one letter's subsequent checks until the next paragraph reset.
design.smallest_falsifier: After a declared reset, any source letter's successive recovered aliases0,0 (without an intervening occurrence of that same letter) contradict the fixed lesson. A threefold repeated source word whose first and third forms differ also contradicts it. These are pre-result formal consequences, not manuscript tests.
design.cost_limit: Ordinary letters occupy one or two working signs, rare characters three; codeword distribution is fixed by alphabetic indices and never fitted here. The tick card and extra alias learning are paid. More readable context variation does not guarantee shorter writing or the inherited metric bands.
design.relation_to_931_and_1180: There is no global toggle drawing, no word reset, and no choice among a few preceding-vowel tables. Each source letter advances its own private-to-that-letter but publicly reconstructible counter. This distinction does not repair931's native bound instance.
